result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom tab bar all render correctly. The only visually broken element is the category chip row, where a sixth chip is cut off at the right edge showing only a meaningless sliver of gray with no label, which reads as a rendering artifact rather than an intentional peek. Horizontally clipped carousel cards and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport are expected scroll affordances and are not reported.

issues.description: At the right edge of the category filter chip row, a sixth chip is clipped so narrowly (a thin gray sliver with no visible label) that it looks like a visual glitch instead of a scroll hint; unlike the restaurant carousel tiles, it provides no readable peek of the next option.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the chip row's horizontal padding/spacing so the next chip peeks with at least its label partially readable (e.g. show 'Desserts' half-visible), or add a fade/scroll indicator at the edge to signal scrollability.
